title: Construct tight-binding Hamiltonian
action: Load the bulk Si three-center tight-binding parametrization from the designated publication and define Si–H on-site energies and coupling elements chosen to passivate dangling bonds. Build the Hamiltonian in a localized basis for the Si:H quantum wire.

title: Define supercell geometry and k-point mesh
action: For wires of cross-section 4×4 and 8×8, construct a periodic supercell with wire axis along an appropriate direction, perpendicular cell vectors along [110] and [1-10], and perpendicular cell side equal to twice the wire side to avoid inter-wire coupling. Set up a uniform k-point mesh by dividing the x, y, z Cartesian axes into 6, 6, and 13 parts.

title: Diagonalize Hamiltonian and compute optical matrix elements
action: For each wire size, diagonalize the tight-binding Hamiltonian at every k-point of the 6×6×13 mesh to obtain eigenenergies and wavefunctions. Compute the momentum matrix elements needed for the dielectric function.

title: Compute DOS for 4×4 wire
action: Using the eigenenergies of the 4×4 wire, produce the density of states by placing a Gaussian of width 100 meV at each sampled energy. Output the DOS as a function of energy.
description: Density of states for the 4×4 hydrogen-terminated Si quantum wire.
output_schema: CSV with header: energy (eV), dos (arb. units). Energy values on a fine regular grid (e.g., 0.01 eV spacing) covering the valence and conduction band region.

title: Compute DOS for 8×8 wire
action: Using the eigenenergies of the 8×8 wire, produce the density of states by placing a Gaussian of width 100 meV at each sampled energy.
description: Density of states for the 8×8 hydrogen-terminated Si quantum wire.
output_schema: CSV with header: energy (eV), dos (arb. units). Energy values on a fine regular grid covering the valence and conduction band region.

title: Compute dielectric function for 4×4 wire
action: From the eigenenergies and optical matrix elements of the 4×4 wire, compute the imaginary part of the dielectric function ε₂(ω) for polarizations parallel and perpendicular to the wire axis using the linear tetrahedral method for k-space integration.
description: Imaginary part of the dielectric function for the 4×4 wire, for parallel and perpendicular polarizations.
output_schema: CSV with header: energy (eV), epsilon2_parallel, epsilon2_perpendicular. Energy grid covering 0 to 10 eV with fine spacing.

title: Compute dielectric function for 8×8 wire
action: From the eigenenergies and optical matrix elements of the 8×8 wire, compute ε₂(ω) for parallel and perpendicular polarizations using the linear tetrahedral method.
description: Imaginary part of the dielectric function for the 8×8 wire, for parallel and perpendicular polarizations.
output_schema: CSV with header: energy (eV), epsilon2_parallel, epsilon2_perpendicular. Energy grid covering 0 to 10 eV with fine spacing.
